message: The '{1}' {0} is virtual, which is not supported by the [Observable] aspect. Remove the 'virtual' modifier, or exclude the {0} from the aspect with the [NotObservable] attribute.
rationale: The message gives no way forward although two fixes exist: removing the modifier, or adding [NotObservable], which excludes the member from both report paths (ValidateRootAutoProperties and DependencyGraphBuilder skip members with this attribute, see the NotObservableVirtualProperty test).
